**Indikator 5** is a clinical quality indicator within the Danish psychiatric healthcare system, managed by the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] and governed by the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] [^src1], [^src4], [^src5]. It measures the proportion of treatment courses in the [[adhd-behandlingspopulation|ADHD-behandlingspopulation]] where the patient or their parents have initiated ADHD-related psychoeducation no later than 120 days after the start of treatment [^src1], [^src5]. The indicator was officially put into operation on May 25, 2021 [^src2]. Its established quality standard and development target is [[90-percent|90%]] [^src2], [^src4], a benchmark it shares with [[indikator-4|Indikator 4]] [^src2].

Despite its clear targets, Indikator 5 has consistently recorded performance levels far below the 90% standard, highlighting a systemic underprioritization of information dissemination and non-pharmacological support for affected families [^src1], [^src4]. For the reporting period of April 1, 2023, to March 31, 2024, the national average was only 34% [^src1]. In the subsequent period from April 1, 2024, to March 31, 2025, the national average dropped slightly to 33% [^src4]. No regions or departments managed to reach the 90% development target during this time [^src5]. Significant regional disparities were observed: [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] recorded the lowest compliance at just 9%, while [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] and [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] both achieved 50% [^src5]. [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] reached 35% and 33%, respectively [^src5]. At the departmental level, outcomes varied drastically; for instance, [[bua-smaborn-klinik|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn]] achieved an 81% psychoeducation rate, whereas PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium in Aabenraa recorded only 5% [^src5]. Furthermore, no patients were registered as having initiated psychoeducation at private hospitals ([[privathospitaler|Privathospitaler]]) [^src5].

Recognizing these shortcomings, the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] has maintained that non-pharmacological treatment initiatives remain crucial for the overall quality of ADHD care [^src5]. Consequently, Indikator 5 will remain a focal point for the steering group in the coming years [^src4]. To make the indicator more precise and meaningful, the group plans to integrate upcoming clinical guidelines on non-pharmacological ADHD treatment developed by the [[danske-multidisciplinaere-psykiatrigrupper-dmpger|Danske Multidisciplinære Psykiatrigrupper (DMPGer)]] [^src4], [^src5]. Specifically, the [[dmpg-retningslinje|DMPG-retningslinje]] for non-pharmacological treatment will be applied in the ongoing revision of the indicator [^src5]. This strategic revision aims to address the structural challenges and registration issues that currently hinder the effective delivery and tracking of psychoeducation across the Danish healthcare sectors [^src4], [^src5].

***

## Claims
**quality-standard**
- Indikator 5 har en standard på ≥ 90 % for andelen af behandlingsforløb, hvor patienten/forældre har påbegyndt ADHD-relateret psykoedukation [^src1]

**statistical**
- Landsgennemsnittet for Indikator 5 i perioden 01.04.2023–31.03.2024 er 34 % (95 % CI: 32–36) [^src1]

**timeline**
- Indikator 5 blev sat i drift den 25/5 2021[^src1]

**performance**
- På landsplan modtog 34 % af ADHD-patienter i pakkeforløb ADHD-relateret psykoedukation inden for tidsfristen[^src1]
- Indikator 5 har et udviklingsmål på ≥ 90 %, men opnåede kun 33 % (95 % CI: 32–35) i perioden 01.04.2024–31.03.2025 [^src1]
- Indikator 5 har et udviklingsmål på ≥ 90 % for perioden 01.04.2024 - 31.03.2025 [^src1]
- På landsplan fik 33 % af ADHD-patienter/forældre psykoedukation inden for tidsfristen [^src1]
- Syddanmark ligger lavest med en andel på 9 % for Indikator 5 [^src1]
- Sjælland og Midtjylland ligger begge på 50 % for Indikator 5 [^src1]
- Hovedstaden og Nordjylland opnåede hhv. 35 og 33 % for Indikator 5 [^src1]
- PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Aabenraa) har en psykoedukationsrate på 5 % [^src1]
- BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn har en psykoedukationsrate på 81 % [^src1]
- Ingen regioner har nået udviklingsmålet på 90 % for Indikator 5 [^src1]
- Ingen afdelinger nåede udviklingsmålet på 90 % for Indikator 5 [^src1]
- Ingen er registreret som påbegyndt psykoedukation på de private hospitaler [^src1]

**standard**
- Standarden for både Indikator 4 og Indikator 5 er 90 %[^src1]

**policy-development**
- Indikator 5 vil blive forbedret i lyset af den kommende DMPG-retningslinje om nonfarmakologisk behandling af ADHD [^src1]

**policy**
- Styregruppen vurderer fortsat at nonfarmakologiske behandlingstiltag er vigtige for kvaliteten af behandlingen af ADHD [^src1]
- Styregruppen vil anvende DMPG-retningslinjen for non-farmakologisk behandling af ADHD i sit videre arbejde med Indikator 5 [^src1]

## Timeline
- **2021-05-25:** Indikator 5 blev sat i drift [^src2]
- **2021:** Indikator 5 blev sat i drift [^src2]
- **01.04.2024 - 31.03.2025:** Opgørelsesperiode for Indikator 5 og Indikator 6 med udviklingsmål på ≥ 90 % [^src5]
